response.transcription:
Orphans' Court Docket, Schuylkill County, Vol. 14, p. 233.

Estate of THOMAS FLYNN, late of the Borough of Minersville, deceased.
April 2, 1889. Will proved; letters testamentary granted to Margaret Flynn and James Connell, executors.
June 10, 1889. Inventory and appraisement filed, $1,240.50.
March 3, 1890. First and final account of the executors filed and confirmed nisi.
